title: Two-coordinate addition law
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer and let $x\in\mathbb{F}_2^n$. For distinct coordinates $i,j$, adding $1$ to both coordinates changes the complete quadratic bit to its original value plus $\sum_{k\ne i}x_k+\sum_{k\ne j}x_k+1$, with the sum taken in $\mathbb{F}_2$.
